title: Runner price file
description: List prices a CI runner service publishes on its own site, usually at /.well-known/runner-prices.json, for tools that estimate what jobs cost. See https://relayrunner.dev/docs/contribute/publish-prices

version.description: The format version. Every version this schema accepts is listed.

rate.description: The rate's id: a runner size or platform, such as linux or acme-4vcpu.

per.description: What one minute of the rate is priced per.

usd_per_minute.description: The list price of one minute in US dollars, as a decimal string.

from.description: The UTC day the price starts. Leave it out for a price that applies now.
